## Description {#details}

<p>A pass which prints the call graph to a <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/raw-ostream">raw_ostream</a></span>.</p>


<p>This is primarily useful for testing the analysis.</p>
